detailed_description: Git Tag Manager generates copyable Git tag commands in the browser. Enter a current version, use major/minor/patch/prerelease bump buttons, choose an annotated or lightweight tag, add an optional message and commit hash, then copy the generated git tag and git push commands. The page also shows a small SemVer guide and common tag commands for listing, showing, and deleting tags. It is a command planner; run the copied commands in your own terminal.
usage_steps: Enter the current version, such as v1.0.0.
Use major, minor, patch, or prerelease to calculate the next tag name.
Choose annotated or lightweight tag type.
Add a tag message and optional commit hash when needed.
Copy the generated git tag and git push commands.
usage_examples: Prepare an annotated v1.2.0 release tag command.
Generate a lightweight tag command for a specific commit hash.
Plan the next SemVer version before cutting a release.
Copy delete/show/list commands as reminders for local terminal work.
